audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits 48.38% over 2592 games: assassin pressure windows vs Ryze's two-item flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart disagreed with content/packet on rows 1-6 (full: Zed,Zed,Skill,Zed,Skill,Skill; content/packet: Skill,Ryze,Zed,Skill,Zed,Ryze). Content also contradicted its own chart: whys[5] says first item leans Zed while spikes[2] and 'late' say it leans you.
audit.why: Content win[] and packet agree; the chart is the authority. First-item row is Zed per both, so spikes[2] and 'late' prose realigned to survival framing.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned with why/rating rewrites; spikes[2].text, late and whys[4] rewritten to agree with their rows; win[] untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: No field stated that Zed is untargetable during the Death Mark dash (missing-interactions rule untargetable-dodges-burst) — the page told you to hold W for his R but not that a W thrown into the blink whiffs. packet defect: full layer never named Living Shadow or its 20s cooldown.
audit.why: Kit R flags: untargetable; W Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16s.
audit.corrected: Untargetable-window and shadow cooldown added to breakdown.cooldowns and phases[4].why.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online: the slow answers his shadow swap and trades stay even — punish only the Qs he throws to farm.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E unlocks the real combo: Flux-root him the instant he shadow-swaps in and Q-E-Q blows him up. Your window.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: His poke and 20s shadow pressure outpace your pre-6 kit — energy refunds keep his Qs cheap. Farm and hold W.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: His R is untargetable through your burst — hold W for the reappear and 6 stays a coin flip. Warp is for the map.

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.
edits.after: RoA alone does not stop the execute — his combo still kills before your stacks matter. Buy Seeker's, keep farming.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items and you eat his combo and answer: EQ deletes, W stops the dive, and Realm Warp wins the objective game.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Death Mark: 120s at rank 1 — he is untargetable during the dash, so root the reappear, never the blink. - Living Shadow: 20s at rank 1 — shadowless Zed cannot trade or escape; that is your window. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip never gets it.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: A centered wave keeps his 900-range shuriken honest and his shadow flanks visible — mid bushes warded, always.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: His passive chunks low-health targets with bonus damage — at half HP one shadow swap turns a stack into a death.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP extends the map game. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: Level 6 is Zed's: his R mark and Electrocute burst ignore your slow Realm Warp.
edits.after: Level 6 skill: his R is lethal but predictable — held W and spacing keep it a coin flip.

edits.before: First item leans your way as Tear/Seeker's stacking gives you HP and armor to survive his combo, and your Q shove lets you deny the roams Zed lives on. Track his shadow cooldown and shove before he can leave lane.
edits.after: First item still leans Zed — his combo can execute you before your stacks matter — but Tear/Seeker's buys survival, and your Q shove denies the roams Zed lives on. Track his shadow cooldown and shove before he can leave lane.

edits.before: First item and especially 2+ items turn the lane over to you: stacked HP and armor let you eat his full combo and survive, your Q chain out-damages his single rotation, and Realm Warp scales into teamfights far better than his all-or-nothing dive.
edits.after: Two-plus items turn the lane over to you: stacked HP and armor let you eat his full combo and survive, your Q chain out-damages his single rotation, and Realm Warp scales into teamfights far better than his all-or-nothing dive.

notes: dontsFull[1].d's 'Zed mark' line is APT here (Zed is the enemy) and was left alone. spikes[1] still frames 6 as 'belongs to Zed' — kept as respect-his-6 advice under the Skill row (the row explainer whys[4] was fixed); flagged in case QA wants it softened.
